description: Calendar names, language-neutral: weekday and month names, the digits, the hour cycle and three date patterns (day: a day's full accessible name; title: a month's title; medium: a picker field's text) per locale, Gregorian calendar. A pattern's tokens are {EEEE} the long weekday, {d} and {dd} the day, {M} and {MM} the month number, {MMMM} the month name from that pattern's own list, and {y} the year, each written in the locale's digits; everything else is literal. A locale missing from the table falls back to its language, then to English. The core tests check the table against the runtime's Intl data; the Flutter adapter carries the same table, and its tests render the same cases.
